Simple Pancakes.

Ingredients.
200 g flour
2 eggs
300 ml milk
1 pinch salt

Whisk the flour, eggs and milk until smooth. Rest the batter for 30 minutes, then fry thin pancakes in a hot buttered pan.

Serves 4.
